leiras: c4 known-failures baseline (docs/plans/c4-vedett-main.md §6). The gate deploys only if every failure is listed in 'bukasok' and every skipped test in 'kimaradhat'. Every entry needs a reason (≥15 characters) and a date. Removing an entry is a normal commit; adding one is allowed with a reason and the robot announces it loudly (Csilla Q3, 2026-10-07). Measured 2026-10-07 on edf3016+c4 in a local gate run: Postgres 18.4, all 154 migrations from scratch, the app with the test AI connector, the image maker on :8601, no outside network.
